rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that someone does something in a similar way.

example.english: I did it similarly to you, and it worked quite well.
example.traditional: 我跟你一樣咁做，效果幾好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gan1 nei5 jat1 joeng6 gam3 zou6 haau6 gwo2 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal or written contexts when explicitly linking the manner of one action to another.

example.english: The two reports similarly point out that rents are still rising.
example.traditional: 兩份報告同樣地指出，房租仍然上升。
example.jyutping: loeng5 fan6 bou3 gou3 tung4 joeng6 dei6 zi2 ceot1 fong4 zou1 jing4 jin4 soeng5 sing1
